item.title: On cam, spooked NATO raises alarm over China-Taiwan war scenario as Russia keeps Europe 'busy'?
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has warned that a potential Chinese move against Taiwan or elsewhere along the first island chain could coincide with Russian pressure in Europe, creating simultaneous crises for the US and its allies. Speaking in Des Moines, Rutte said Europe must strengthen its conventional defence as Washington faces growing demands in the Indo-Pacific. US Ambassador to NATO Matthew Whitaker backed the warning, highlighting the risk of sophisticated hybrid attacks targeting infrastructure and technology. The discussion also covered Arctic security, Ukraine and suspected Russian hybrid operations in Europe, as NATO reassesses its future defence responsibilities.

item.title: North Korea tests new hypersonic missile as Xi & Putin's nuclear ally Kim puts US bases on notice?
item.description: North Korea has released imagery of a new hypersonic missile test conducted on September 20, featuring the Hwasong-11MA-1. The test reportedly involved a short-range ballistic missile booster fitted with a hypersonic glide vehicle capable of maneuvering during flight. North Korean claims put the missile’s speed at 2,146 metres per second, with a reported flight distance of 908.2 kilometres. Kim Jong Un observed the test alongside his daughter Kim Ju Ae and senior missile officials. However, the available imagery does not independently confirm the missile’s full maneuvering capability, accuracy or operational reliability. The test raises fresh questions over North Korea’s advancing hypersonic weapons programme.
